message: Astra: Within Ya na’s scene, would the latest dialogue let you recognize either speaker without their names, and which wording supports your judgment? What deserves closer attention before changing their voices? Why would further thought earn its time over an informative revision now; conversely, what uncertainty could make revision premature? What evidence would justify either choice? Could you briefly state your finding, remaining uncertainty, and chosen intention in English, then carry out that choice?
